title: 7-day answer-timing window silently drops legitimate in-TTL referee submissions (fake 'Saved' on the JS path)
detail: Page-load age over 7 days fails the timing check, but the link TTL is 10 days. A referee submitting from a tab open >7 days (within TTL) is silently dropped; the JS path even shows 'Saved'. Legitimate data loss.
recommended_fix: Raise the upper bound above the 10-day TTL (e.g. 864_000_000) or re-stamp _form_loaded_at on tab visibility/return, so in-TTL referees are never dropped and autosave stays truthful.
